policy: Only primary experiments or institutional test reports are used. Published aggregates are retained with their device, operating condition, extraction method, uncertainty status, and word-model mapping assumptions.

sources.title: Study of Multicell Upsets in SRAM at a 5-nm Bulk FinFET Node
sources.device_technology: custom single-port and two-port SRAM arrays, 5-nm bulk FinFET

extracted_statistics.quantity: MCU event fraction under alpha exposure below 550 mV
extracted_statistics.extraction_method: conservative lower bound from the paper statement that MBUs contribute more than 15% for both SRAM designs
extracted_statistics.confidence_interval: not reported for this extracted statement
mapping_assumptions: the interval is scenario-specific and not pooled with neutron or FPGA data

extracted_statistics.value: an upset within three cells of an existing cluster member is assigned to the same MCU
mapping_assumptions: physical cell distance cannot be converted to logical word adjacency without a layout/interleaving map

sources.title: Statistical Method to Extract Radiation-Induced Multiple-Cell Upsets in SRAM-Based FPGAs
sources.device_technology: Xilinx 7-Series, UltraScale, and UltraScale+ SRAM FPGA CRAM; 7-Series BRAM

extracted_statistics.confidence_interval: not published in reusable numeric form
not published in reusable numeric form
not published in reusable numeric form

mapping_assumptions: device-family values define a sensitivity range, not a pooled population confidence interval
CRAM/BRAM physical addresses are not mapped directly to a 72-bit SRAM word

sources.title: Evaluating Built-in ECC of FPGA On-chip Memories for the Mitigation of Undervolting Faults
sources.device_technology: commercial FPGA block RAM under voltage underscaling

extracted_statistics.quantity: additional faults detectable but not correctable

mapping_assumptions: correctable is treated as an SBU aggregate only because the authors attribute the result to single-bit faults
the 7% detected category is not converted to a bit-exact DBU PMF

sources.title: Hardware Versus Software Fault Injection of Modern Undervolted SRAMs
sources.device_technology: 28-nm 16-Kbit SRAM fault maps from commercial FPGA BRAM experiments

extracted_statistics.quantity: faulty SRAM maps with 2, 4, 6, and 8 faulty bits
extracted_statistics.extraction_method: reported histogram percentages among faulty maps

extracted_statistics.value: faults cluster by column and exhibit voltage inclusion

mapping_assumptions: persistent faulty-bit count per SRAM macro is not event multiplicity within one ECC word
spatial locality is used as a structured uncertainty constraint, not as a direct transient PMF

sources.title: Xilinx Kintex-UltraScale Field Programmable Gate Array Single Event Effects Heavy-Ion Test Report
sources.device_technology: Kintex UltraScale FPGA BRAM, 256 RAMB36 blocks, 8-bit data width

extracted_statistics.value: post-processing classifies 1-bit, 2-bit, 3-bit, and higher errors with stated >=95% event-association confidence
extracted_statistics.confidence_interval: histogram values were not recoverable from the public report text used here

mapping_assumptions: methodological evidence only; no numeric PMF constraint is instantiated without the histogram

conclusion: The available evidence supports source-specific aggregate ambiguity sets, not one pooled measured word-level PMF. Literature-derived and synthetic artifacts remain separate.
